title: Complexity-Regularized Proximal Policy Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2509.20509v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Policy gradient methods usually rely on entropy regularization to prevent premature convergence. However, maximizing entropy indiscriminately pushes the policy towards a uniform distribution, often overriding the reward signal if not optimally tuned. We propose replacing the standard entropy term with a self-regulating complexity term, defined as the product of Shannon entropy and disequilibrium, which quantifies the distance from the uniform distribution. Unlike pure entropy, which favors maximal disorder, this complexity measure is zero for both fully deterministic and perfectly uniform distributions, i.e., it is strictly positive for systems that exhibit a meaningful interplay between order and randomness. These properties ensure the policy maintains beneficial stochasticity while reducing regularization pressure when the policy is highly uncertain, allowing learning to focus on reward optimization. We introduce Complexity-R

translated_title: 复杂度正则化的近端策略优化
translated_abstract: 策略梯度方法通常依赖熵正则化来防止过早收敛。然而，不加区分地最大化熵会将策略推向均匀分布，若调参不当，往往会压过奖励信号的作用。我们提出用一种自调节的复杂度项来替代标准的熵项，该复杂度项定义为香农熵与非平衡度的乘积，用于量化与均匀分布之间的距离。与偏好最大无序性的纯熵不同，这种复杂度度量在完全确定性分布和完全均匀分布下均为零，即只有在秩序与随机性之间表现出有意义相互作用的系统中，它才严格为正。这些特性确保策略保持有益的随机性，同时在策略高度不确定时降低正则化压力，使学习能够专注于奖励优化。我们提出了复杂度正则化的近端策略优化（CR-PPO）……
tldr: 该论文提出用香农熵与非平衡度乘积构成的自调节复杂度项替代传统熵正则化来改进近端策略优化（PPO），在保持策略有益随机性的同时，当策略高度不确定时降低正则化压力，从而让学习更专注于奖励优化。
en_tdlr: This paper replaces standard entropy regularization in PPO with a self-regulating complexity term (the product of Shannon entropy and disequilibrium), which maintains beneficial policy stochasticity while reducing regularization pressure when the policy is highly uncertain, allowing learning to focus on reward optimization.
